scope: All 48 final decisions of structured and shuffled, including all 38 valid nonempty final citations; round 0-2 and no_active are not semantically rated. This is a single unblinded assistant review of source-target relation alignment, not a scientific correctness or citation-accuracy score.

rubric.relation_aligned: Declared relation consistent with the mechanism text actually present under the cited id; does not validate its existence in the target.
rubric.partial_or_mixed: Some overlap but mixes extra mechanisms or omits a defining condition.
rubric.insufficient_or_conflicting: Vague relation, unsupported implication, or conflict with supplied mechanism text.
rubric.invalid_source: Identifier does not locate a supplied card.

evidence_limit: Final conditions were proposed after the final selection with no remaining experiment; they are not recorded successful falsification tests.
